closed note 4581715 (near 1013, Tabán, 1st district) / Created 2 days ago by Gyrostat
Number of steps is different along the way via StreetComplete 60.0 Attached photo(s): https://streetcomplete.app/p/256749.jpg / Resolved 1 day ago by infeeeee
Separated to 2 stairs. One with 2 steps on the Northern end without handrail, one with 8 steps on the Southern end with handrail. This way if someone needs a handrail would be routed to the southern stairs, but if someone prefers less steps could use the northern part. Afaik we don't have currently a much better way to draw this complex situation. https://www.openstreetmap.org/changeset/161166770
